factor_semantics.scope1_residual_factor: Combined residual process-gas emissions relative to the matched current baseline after gas use, release, and abatement.
factor_semantics.scope2_grid_ci_factor: Use the same fab electricity with grid carbon intensity scaled relative to the matched current baseline.
factor_semantics.upstream_factor: Supported upstream term scaled separately; no claim of complete Scope 3.

warning: Endpoints are declared research bounds, not measured fab values, probabilities, or promises. Apply only to a source-matched current Scope-1/2/upstream breakdown.
